summary: Layer 1B expands the public-market universe around the substrate-materials chokepoint below AI accelerator packaging. The strongest direct exposure remains non-US primary-listed Japanese/Taiwanese names that trade in the US mainly via OTC ADR/ordinary lines. The reference lane is needed because Ajinomoto, Ibiden, and Unimicron define the chokepoint map, but the underfollowed lane should focus on MEC Company’s copper-resin adhesion chemistry and, secondarily, broad electronics-materials suppliers such as DuPont whose exposure is real but diluted.
